cases.user_prompt: Create a CLI tool called word_counter that counts words from --text or stdin.

expected_spec.description: Counts words from --text flag or standard input.

cases.reference_code:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import argparse
import sys

def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Word counter')
    parser.add_argument('--text', type=str, default=None)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    data = args.text if args.text is not None else sys.stdin.read()
    print(len(data.split()))
    return 0

if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())

cases.user_prompt: Create a CLI utility called json_sorter that reads JSON from stdin and outputs sorted keys.

expected_spec.description: Reads JSON from stdin and prints sorted single-line JSON.

cases.reference_code:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import argparse
import json
import sys

def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='JSON key sorter')
    parser.parse_args()
    obj = json.loads(sys.stdin.read())
    print(json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True))
    return 0

if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())
